name: atr_channel_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: Keltner Channel breakouts (close > EMA_20 + 2*ATR_20) with declining VIX signal legitimate expansion, not noise. The ATR-based channel adapts to current volatility, making breakouts more meaningful than fixed-percentage levels. Edge exists because Keltner Channels are less popular than Bollinger Bands in India, reducing crowding. Institutional flow that causes a genuine channel breakout persists for 15-45 bars.
stock_filter: top 30 FnO by avg daily turnover

long.confirmation: bar closes above kc_upper with strong volume

short.confirmation: bar closes below kc_lower with strong volume

filters.time_filter: no entries first 15 min or last 30 min

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — ATR-based channels adapt to conditions; less prone to overfitting

weaknesses: Channel breakout on 1-min can be noisy — many false breakouts during lunch hour
Stop at ema_20 can be far from entry if ATR is large, increasing risk per trade
In low-vol environments, channel is narrow and breakouts are frequent but meaningless
prior_art: Keltner Channel breakout — Chester Keltner / Linda Raschke. Well-established.
notes: Test with 1.5x and 2.5x ATR multipliers for channel width optimization.
